brief.aim: The table is the UCI bank direct-marketing campaign data, evidently assembled to predict whether a client subscribes to a term deposit; the only outcome column is the two-level 'y' (no/yes), so binary classification with the workflow default metric. 'duration' is the call length, which is only known after the call and is strongly determined by the outcome, so it is a leakage suspect and not a feature; 'day'/'month' record campaign timing rather than a single ordered series, so no time columns or grouping are declared.
brief.repeated_subjects: No client/customer identifier is present; rows are treated as independent contacts, though the same client may in principle be contacted more than once (not detectable from these columns).
brief.unit: One direct-marketing phone contact with a bank client (row = a single campaign contact attempt)
